title: OpenAI connector (Beta)
body:
The OpenAI connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector uses the OpenAI Organization Admin API to ingest organization administration data, such as users, projects, API keys, usage, costs, and audit logs, from OpenAI into Databricks. Authentication uses an OpenAI Admin API key.

See [OpenAI connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/openai).
